name: oracle-template-drift
cost_provenance: estimated 2026-06-18 (pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01): hashes up to ~5 functional files across every installed project oracle; under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) each sha256sum is a fork, so ~30-60 forks dominate. Under-declaration causes timeout kills; 3x-declared briefing timeout (9000ms) stays within the 15000ms budget.
question: Does any oracle installed in this project's .claude/oracles/ differ from the current framework baseline (a starter-pack fix the project never received)?

schema.drifted: boolean (true when one or more compared oracles differ from baseline)
schema.drifted_oracles: array of {name: string, files: array of string} -- per-oracle list of functional files that differ from (or are missing vs) baseline
schema.compared_count: integer (oracles present in BOTH project and baseline, not pinned)
schema.missing_starter: array of string (PACK-02 additive extension: PACK_MANIFEST.json packs.starter entries with no installed project dir; empty when manifest absent)
schema.briefing: string (empty when no drift AND no missing-starter gaps; otherwise a one-line /0-uldf-migrate-oracles nudge naming drift and/or missing counts)

output.schema_extended_additively: 2026-07-02 (PACK-02): missing_starter + missing_count fields and the missing-only briefing form added; the frozen base fields and `drifted` semantics (content drift of INSTALLED oracles only) are unchanged

fallback: For each oracle directory under <project>/.claude/oracles/ that also exists under ~/.claude/oracles/ (or claude-template/oracles/ via walk-up) and lacks a .local-customized marker, compare the CR-normalized content of the 5 functional files (oracle.json, run.sh, run.ps1, validate.sh, validate.ps1); a project copy that differs from (or is missing relative to) the baseline copy is drift. README.md and test-fixtures/ are NOT compared. When no drift: briefing is empty. When drift: 'oracle-template-drift: N oracle(s) drifted from framework baseline — run /0-uldf-migrate-oracles to refresh'.

baseline_resolution.graceful_absent: When no baseline oracle dir found: drifted=false, briefing='', exit 0

project_resolution.graceful_absent: When project oracle dir missing or empty: drifted=false, compared_count=0, briefing='', exit 0

customization_opt_out.semantics: A project oracle directory containing a .local-customized file is skipped by BOTH this oracle (never flagged as drift) and /0-uldf-migrate-oracles (never re-copied). Escape hatch for intentionally-divergent project oracles.

briefing_line_convention: Empty briefing string = suppress line (per ULDF gracefully-absent convention). Hook MUST NOT print a 'no drift' fallback.

provenance.note: Companion to /0-uldf-migrate-oracles. Surfaces installed-oracle drift in the session-start ORACLE BRIEFING so projects that ran /0-uldf-setup-project (add-only installer) before a starter-oracle fix get nudged to refresh. Sibling of gitignore-template-drift (the .gitignore-pattern equivalent of this same propagation-gap pattern); pending follow-up #11 (docs/pending/project-artifact-refresh-mechanism.md).
